notes.title: [Important Announcement] Hades Relic Package Issue Update #1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/8f86860edd7ee12847e3299789f5c1face140b72.png
Greetings Everyone, this is GM OceanSunfish

A while ago the Hades Relic Package was sent out into the shop and contained incorrect content as it was supposed to contain weapons but instead gears were delivered instead.

Please be noted that as told last time, users are given the opportunity to exchange the package content to it's correct items.

With that said, the initial sending of the items will be sent out this maintenance (Sept 16, 2025)

For those who have sent in inquiries or directly messaged me over at the official Discord, please do ensure that you have sent in your in-game names as to have the items corrected.

and of course, as per the previous post, you are also free to keep the Gears instead of exchanging them.

If you still wish to exchange the items or you have not received your package after this maintenance, please do contact me over at Discord or file a ticket with the title [Hades Relic Package] as we will be doing another batch one final time on the next scheduled bi-weekly maintenance.

Thank you for your continued playing of Combat Arms The Classic, and have a nice day.

notes.title: PATCH BRIEFING 04.12.2024
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/6f7c2a4cb572d81c360167e5ec2113e258f6cec3.pngPATCH BRIEFING

Hello, Rangers!

GM-vChaos here reporting in our patch briefing.

For this patch, we are trying out new ways of approach based on popular demand along with new weapons into our arsenal.

Let's take a look of the changes we are about to make.

BALANCE
Weapon Rebalance is one of the interesting topics that has been the word of mouth for a long time.
Our developers tread in this path very carefully and always looking for ways to give Rangers a fair fight against each other.

Based on the data, game experience and feedback, we have chosen one particular SMG
that has been bringing Rangers at the top of the battlefield. Stay tuned for more.

MAP UPDATES
I'm compiling an update for Terror Dome. I received a lot of feedback from competitive players, 
so I made some changes to make the map more balanced for both teams.

Terrordome Patch Notes:
- Fixed exploits that allowed players to leave the map
- Removed B-site alarms from Search & Destroy mode
- Various changes to improve map balance 
- Lowered ambient sound volume
- Improved lighting in Quarantine mode

We have also opened Game Modes for players to enjoy.
Arms Race
Capture the Flag
Last man standing
Quarantine Regen(HOT)
Spy Hunt
VIP Elimination

FIXES
Part of our patch briefing tackles some fixes that were reported by users.

> Fixed Wheel of Fate inventory that did not update last patch.
In my defense, GMChaos was hungry at the time and we're giving him more cheese.

> Fixed an issue where purchasing DarkHorizon's Package and Uruchi's Alternative Package causes an error to show.

We are hoping that these features are enjoyed by our players and as always,
if you have any ideas, GMvChaos is ready to jot them down for you.

For the community,
GM-vChaos

NEW FUNCTION

Room Rank Restriction

1. When the players create a room, they can give the room a certain rank limit (which did not exist until the update). There are currently two new restrictions:
1-30 (Rookie Zone)
31-60 (Veteran Zone)

2. There are some conditions to create restricted-rank rooms
The players whose rank under 30 can only create Rookie Zone and non-restricted Zone.
The players whose rank from 31-49 can only create non-restricted Zone.
The players whose rank over 50 can only create Veteran Zone and non-restricted Zone.

3. When a player creates a room, he or she can choose the corresponding rank limit or not. Once created, players can also change the settings for rank limits. However, players can only switch from Rookie/Veterans to unrestricted, not from unrestricted to Rookie/Veterans. Similarly, Rookie and Veteran cannot have switched each other.

4. Rooms that have created restrictions have an explicit icon in the list of rooms in the lobby, and no-icon indicate no-restrictions.

5. No password can be set for Rookie/Veteran restricted rooms.
